  1274	\begin{dfn}\label{df:aPf}

  1276	 category of (locally Noetherian) $S$-schemes $T$ to the category of

  1281	The absolute Picard functor  is a ``prepared presheaf'' in this
  1282	sense: given any family of  $S$-schemes $T_i$, we have
  1283		$$\Pic_X\bigl(\textstyle\coprod T_i\bigr)=\prod\Pic_X(T_i).$$

  1287	to $\Pic_X$, in working simply with the single map $T'\to T$ where
  1288	$T':=\coprod T_i$.  And doing so lightens the notation, making for
  1289	easier reading. Therefore, we do so throughout, calling $T'\to T$ simply

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AdmissibleDivisorQuasiProjective

open CategoryTheory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

#check isClosedImmersion_divRepAffAdmissibleRawEmbedding
#check isClosedImmersion_divRepAffAdmissibleConcreteEmbedding
#check isClosedImmersion_divRepAffAdmissibleEmbedding
#print axioms isClosedImmersion_divRepAffAdmissibleRawEmbedding
#print axioms isClosedImmersion_divRepAffAdmissibleConcreteEmbedding
#print axioms isClosedImmersion_divRepAffAdmissibleEmbedding

example {k : Type} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
    IsClosedImmersion (divRepAffAdmissibleConcreteEmbedding C).left :=
  isClosedImmersion_divRepAffAdmissibleConcreteEmbedding C

example {k : Type} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
    IsClosedImmersion (divRepAffAdmissibleEmbedding C).left :=
  isClosedImmersion_divRepAffAdmissibleEmbedding C

end AlgebraicGeometry
EOF"

     9	/-!
    10	# The kernel of the widened Abel transformation
    11	
    12	This module identifies equality under `chartValueAff` with relative linear equivalence.  The
    13	two fixed twist factors cancel, equality in `picEt` is detected on every affine open because
    14	the etale-plus unit is injective, and `relPicMk_eq_relPicMk_iff` identifies the remaining
    15	relation with the quotient by `picFromBase`.
    16	
    17	The last theorem is the concrete relation that an Altman--Kleiman quotient of the admissible
    18	divisor representer must represent.  No quotient scheme or representability conclusion is
    19	asserted here.
    20	-/
    21	
    22	set_option autoImplicit false
    23	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    24	
    25	universe u
    26	
    27	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite
    28	
    29	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    30	
    31	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    32	
    33	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} {n : ℕ}
    34	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    35	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    36	
    37	noncomputable section
    38	
    39	variable (C n) in
    40	/-- The fixed sigma and theta twists do not change the kernel of the widened Abel map. -/
    41	theorem chartValueAff_eq_iff_abelDivAff'_eq
    42	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    43	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (s₁ s₂ : divFamZarAff C n T) :
    44	    chartValueAff C n m Z T s₁ = chartValueAff C n m Z T s₂
    45	      ↔ abelDivAff' C n T s₁ = abelDivAff' C n T s₂ := by
    46	  rw [chartValueAff, chartValueAff, mul_left_inj, mul_left_inj]
    47	
    48	omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] in
    49	variable (C n) in
    50	/-- Equality of widened Abel values is equality of their relative Picard classes on every
    51	affine open of the test scheme. -/
    52	theorem abelDivAff'_eq_iff_forall_relPicMk_picClass_eq
    53	    [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
    54	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (s₁ s₂ : divFamZarAff C n T) :
    55	    abelDivAff' C n T s₁ = abelDivAff' C n T s₂
    56	      ↔ ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens,
    57	          relPicMk C (overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1)) (s₁.1 U).picClass
    58	            = relPicMk C (overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1)) (s₂.1 U).picClass :=
    59	  ⟨fun h U => PicEtAff.unit_injective C _ (congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val h) U),
    60	    fun h => picEt.ext fun U => congrArg (PicEtAff.unit C _) (h U)⟩
    61	
    62	variable (C n) in
    63	/-- Equality of widened chart values is equality of the relative Picard classes of the
    64	underlying divisor families, affine-locally on the test scheme. -/
    65	theorem chartValueAff_eq_iff_forall_relPicMk_picClass_eq
    66	    [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
    67	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    68	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (s₁ s₂ : divFamZarAff C n T) :
    69	    chartValueAff C n m Z T s₁ = chartValueAff C n m Z T s₂
    70	      ↔ ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens,
    71	          relPicMk C (overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1)) (s₁.1 U).picClass
    72	            = relPicMk C (overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1)) (s₂.1 U).picClass :=
    73	  (chartValueAff_eq_iff_abelDivAff'_eq C n m Z T s₁ s₂).trans
    74	    (abelDivAff'_eq_iff_forall_relPicMk_picClass_eq C n T s₁ s₂)
    75	
    76	variable (C n) in
    77	/-- The concrete kernel relation of the widened chart: on every affine open, the ratio of the
    78	two divisor Picard classes is pulled back from the base. -/
    79	theorem chartValueAff_eq_iff_forall_picClass_div_mem_picFromBase
    80	    [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
    81	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    82	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (s₁ s₂ : divFamZarAff C n T) :
    83	    chartValueAff C n m Z T s₁ = chartValueAff C n m Z T s₂
    84	      ↔ ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens,
    85	          (s₁.1 U).picClass / (s₂.1 U).picClass
    86	            ∈ picFromBase C (overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1)) := by
    87	  rw [chartValueAff_eq_iff_forall_relPicMk_picClass_eq C n m Z T s₁ s₂]
    88	  exact forall_congr' fun _ => relPicMk_eq_relPicMk_iff C
    89	
    90	/-! ## The concrete map from the admissible divisor representer -/
    91	
    92	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver in
    93	variable (C) in
    94	/-- The internally chosen multiplicity of the uniform admissible Abel datum. -/
    95	def admissibleAbelChartIndex : ℕ := by
    96	  classical
    97	  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
    98	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    99	    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
   100	  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
   101	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   102	    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
   103	  haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   104	    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
   105	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
   106	    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
   107	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
   108	    moduleFinite_hModule_one C
   109	  exact (exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ
   110	    (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) (genus C) (chi_moduleKSheaf C)).choose
   111	
   112	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver in
   113	variable (C) in
   114	/-- The internally chosen divisor of the uniform admissible Abel datum. -/
   115	def admissibleAbelChartDivisor : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor := by
   116	  classical
   117	  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
   118	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   119	    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
   120	  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
   121	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   122	    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
   123	  haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   124	    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
   125	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
   126	    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
   127	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
   128	    moduleFinite_hModule_one C
   129	  exact (exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ
   130	    (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) (genus C)
   131	      (chi_moduleKSheaf C)).choose_spec.choose
   132	
   133	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver in
   134	variable (C) in
   135	/-- The chosen admissible Abel datum has the degree required by `chartValueAffTrans`. -/
   136	theorem admissibleAbelChartDivisor_degree :
   137	    Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k (admissibleAbelChartDivisor C)
   138	      = (admissibleAbelChartIndex C : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C)
   139	        - (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C : ℤ) := by
   140	  classical
   141	  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
   142	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   143	    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
   144	  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
   145	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   146	    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
   147	  haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   148	    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
   149	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
   150	    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
   151	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
   152	    moduleFinite_hModule_one C
   153	  exact (exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ
   154	    (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) (genus C)
   155	      (chi_moduleKSheaf C)).choose_spec.choose_spec.1
   156	
   157	variable (C) in
   158	/-- The concrete admissible `chartValueAffTrans`, with its legal Abel datum chosen internally. -/
   159	def admissibleChartValueAffTrans :
   160	    divFunctorAff C (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C) ⟶ pic0TypeFunctor C :=
   161	  chartValueAffTrans C (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C)
   162	    (admissibleAbelChartIndex C) (admissibleAbelChartDivisor C)
   163	      (admissibleAbelChartDivisor_degree C)
   164	
   165	variable (C) in
   166	/-- The concrete admissible Abel transformation in the slice over `Spec k`.  Its body directly
   167	consumes the unconditional admissible divisor representation. -/
   168	def admissibleAbelTrans :
   169	    yoneda.obj (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C) ⟶ pic0TypeFunctor C :=
   170	  (divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C).toIso.hom ≫
   171	    admissibleChartValueAffTrans C
   172	
   173	variable (C) in
   174	/-- The ambient admissible Abel map is exactly the canonical sigma extension of the concrete
   175	map in the slice over `Spec k`.  This is the comparison needed to consume the separate
   176	etale-local-surjectivity theorem without adding a representability or surjectivity binder. -/
   177	theorem abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible_eq_sigmaExtension_admissibleAbelTrans :
   178	    abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C =
   179	      (CategoryTheory.Functor.RepresentableBy.yoneda
   180	          (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C)).toSigmaExtension ≫
   181	        Over.sigmaExtensionNat (admissibleAbelTrans C) := by
   182	  rfl
   183	
   184	variable (C) in
   185	/-- Evaluation of the represented admissible Abel map classifies the corresponding widened
   186	divisor family and applies the concrete chart transformation. -/
   187	@[simp]
   188	theorem admissibleAbelTrans_app {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   189	    (q : T ⟶ divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C) :
   190	    (admissibleAbelTrans C).app (op T) q =
   191	      (admissibleChartValueAffTrans C).app (op T)
   192	        ((divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C).homEquiv q) :=
   193	  rfl
   194	
   195	variable (C) in
   196	/-- The kernel of the concrete admissible Abel transformation is precisely relative linear
   197	equivalence, including the quotient by classes pulled back from the base. -/
   198	theorem admissibleAbelTrans_app_eq_iff_forall_picClass_div_mem_picFromBase
   199	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (q₁ q₂ : T ⟶ divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C) :
   200	    (admissibleAbelTrans C).app (op T) q₁ = (admissibleAbelTrans C).app (op T) q₂
   201	      ↔ ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens,
   202	          (((divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C).homEquiv q₁).1 U).picClass /
   203	              (((divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C).homEquiv q₂).1 U).picClass
   204	            ∈ picFromBase C (overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1)) := by
   205	  unfold admissibleAbelTrans admissibleChartValueAffTrans
   206	  constructor
   207	  · intro h
   208	    apply (chartValueAff_eq_iff_forall_picClass_div_mem_picFromBase C
   209	      (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C) (admissibleAbelChartIndex C)
   210	        (admissibleAbelChartDivisor C) T
   211	          ((divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C).homEquiv q₁)
   212	          ((divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C).homEquiv q₂)).mp
   213	    exact congrArg Subtype.val h
   214	  · intro h
   215	    apply Subtype.ext
   216	    exact (chartValueAff_eq_iff_forall_picClass_div_mem_picFromBase C
   217	      (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C) (admissibleAbelChartIndex C)
   218	        (admissibleAbelChartDivisor C) T
   219	          ((divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C).homEquiv q₁)
   220	          ((divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C).homEquiv q₂)).mpr h
   221	
   222	end

    24	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]

    27	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]
    28	variable (D : BasicOpenCoverData C B pi)

    30	/-- The comparison of sections on a datum piece with sections on its base change. -/
    31	noncomputable def piecesMap : ∀ j : D.index,
    32	    Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) →+*
    33	      Γ(relCurve C B', (D.baseChange B').pieces j)
    34	  | .inl j => pieceSectionsMap B' (fiberChart₀ pi) (D.h₀ j)
    35	  | .inr j => pieceSectionsMap B' (fiberChart₁ pi) (D.h₁ j)
    36	
    37	/-- Base change commutes with the basic-open localization defining each datum piece. -/
    38	noncomputable def pieceTermBaseChange : ∀ j : D.index,
    39	    B' ⊗[B] Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) ≃ₐ[B']
    40	      Γ(relCurve C B', (D.baseChange B').pieces j)
    41	  | .inl j =>
    42	      pieceTermBaseChangeAlg B' (fiberChart₀ pi)
    43	        (fiberTwoCover pi).isAffineOpen₀.isCompact
    44	        (fiberTwoCover pi).isAffineOpen₀.isQuasiSeparated
    45	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover pi))
    46	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B' (fiberTwoCover pi)) (D.h₀ j)
    47	  | .inr j =>
    48	      pieceTermBaseChangeAlg B' (fiberChart₁ pi)
    49	        (fiberTwoCover pi).isAffineOpen₁.isCompact
    50	        (fiberTwoCover pi).isAffineOpen₁.isQuasiSeparated
    51	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B (fiberTwoCover pi))
    52	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B' (fiberTwoCover pi)) (D.h₁ j)
    53	
    54	/-- The datum-piece base-change equivalence sends `1 ⊗ t` to the compared section. -/
    55	theorem pieceTermBaseChange_one_tmul (j : D.index)
    56	    (t : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j)) :
    57	    D.pieceTermBaseChange B' j ((1 : B') ⊗ₜ[B] t) = D.piecesMap B' j t := by
    58	  cases j with
    59	  | inl j =>
    60	      exact pieceTermBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul B' (fiberChart₀ pi)
    61	        (fiberTwoCover pi).isAffineOpen₀.isCompact
    62	        (fiberTwoCover pi).isAffineOpen₀.isQuasiSeparated
    63	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover pi))
    64	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B' (fiberTwoCover pi)) (D.h₀ j) t
    65	  | inr j =>
    66	      exact pieceTermBaseChangeAlg_one_tmul B' (fiberChart₁ pi)
    67	        (fiberTwoCover pi).isAffineOpen₁.isCompact
    68	        (fiberTwoCover pi).isAffineOpen₁.isQuasiSeparated
    69	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B (fiberTwoCover pi))
    70	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B' (fiberTwoCover pi)) (D.h₁ j) t

    82	/-- Compare a global glued section along a change of coefficient ring. -/
    83	noncomputable def sectionsMapTop (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    84	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤)) :
    85	    ↥(gluedSubmodule B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit ⊤) :=
    86	  D.sectionsMap B' (by rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top]) s
    87	
    88	/-- Components of the compared global section are the compared original components. -/
    89	theorem component_sectionsMapTop (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    90	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤)) (j : D.index) :
    91	    (D.baseChange B').component (D.sectionsMapTop B' s) j =
    92	      D.toBasicOpenCoverData.piecesMap B' j (D.component s j) := by
    93	  let htop : (⊤ : (relCurve C B').Opens) ≤
    94	      relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens) := by
    95	    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top]
    96	  cases j with
    97	  | inl j =>
    98	      simpa only [sectionsMapTop, component, sectionsMap_coe,
    99	        BasicOpenCocycleDatum.baseChange, BasicOpenCoverData.piecesMap,
   100	        BasicOpenCoverData.pieces, BasicOpenCoverData.baseChange,
   101	        Sum.elim_inl, pieceSectionsMap] using
   102	        (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   103	          (le_inf le_top le_rfl : D.pieces (Sum.inl j) ≤ ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces (Sum.inl j))
   104	          (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' htop (Sum.inl j))
   105	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' (Sum.inl j))
   106	          (le_inf le_top le_rfl : (D.baseChange B').pieces (Sum.inl j) ≤
   107	            ⊤ ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces (Sum.inl j)) (s.val (Sum.inl j))
   108	  | inr j =>
   109	      simpa only [sectionsMapTop, component, sectionsMap_coe,
   110	        BasicOpenCocycleDatum.baseChange, BasicOpenCoverData.piecesMap,
   111	        BasicOpenCoverData.pieces, BasicOpenCoverData.baseChange,
   112	        Sum.elim_inr, pieceSectionsMap] using
   113	        (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   114	          (le_inf le_top le_rfl : D.pieces (Sum.inr j) ≤ ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces (Sum.inr j))
   115	          (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' htop (Sum.inr j))
   116	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' (Sum.inr j))
   117	          (le_inf le_top le_rfl : (D.baseChange B').pieces (Sum.inr j) ≤
   118	            ⊤ ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces (Sum.inr j)) (s.val (Sum.inr j))

   123	-- The glued trivialization carries a large dependent family of section rings.
   124	-- A nonzero global section of a cocycle-glued line bundle on an integral scheme is
   125	-- nonzero in every nonempty trivializing piece.
   126	theorem component_ne_zero_of_global_ne_zero
   127	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C K)] (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C K pi)
   128	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule K D.pieces D.unit ⊤)) (hs : s ≠ 0)
   129	    (j : D.index) (hj : D.pieces j ≠ ⊥) : D.component s j ≠ 0 := by
   130	  intro hcomponent
   131	  apply hs
   132	  have hUj : ((D.pieces j : Set (relCurve C K))).Nonempty := by
   133	    rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty (D.pieces j : Set (relCurve C K)) with h | h
   134	    · exact (hj (by ext x; rw [h]; simp)).elim
   135	    · exact h
   136	  have hres : gluedRes K D.pieces D.unit (le_top : D.pieces j ≤ ⊤) s = 0 := by
   137	    apply (gluedTriv K D.isGluingCocycle j le_rfl).injective
   138	    rw [map_zero, gluedTriv_apply, gluedRes_coe]
   139	    simpa only [component, Scheme.resHom_resHom] using hcomponent
   140	  apply Subtype.ext
   141	  funext i
   142	  by_cases hi : D.pieces i = ⊥
   143	  · have hopen : ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces i = ⊥ := by rw [hi]; simp
   144	    letI : Subsingleton Γ(relCurve C K, ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces i) := hopen ▸ inferInstance
   145	    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
   146	  · have hUi : ((D.pieces i : Set (relCurve C K))).Nonempty := by
   147	      rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty (D.pieces i : Set (relCurve C K)) with h | h
   148	      · exact (hi (by ext x; rw [h]; simp)).elim
   149	      · exact h
   150	    have hUji : (((D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces i : (relCurve C K).Opens) :
   151	        Set (relCurve C K))).Nonempty := by
   152	      simpa only [Opens.coe_inf] using
   153	        nonempty_preirreducible_inter (D.pieces j).isOpen (D.pieces i).isOpen hUj hUi
   154	    letI : Nonempty ↥((D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces i : (relCurve C K).Opens) :
   155	        Set (relCurve C K)) := by
   156	      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hUji
   157	      exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩⟩
   158	    have hinj : Function.Injective ((relCurve C K).resHom
   159	        (show D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces i ≤ ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces i by simp)) :=
   160	      map_injective_of_isIntegral (H := this) (relCurve C K)
   161	        (homOfLE (show D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces i ≤ ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces i by simp))
   162	    apply hinj
   163	    have hval := congrArg (fun t => t.val i) hres
   164	    simpa only [gluedRes_coe, Pi.zero_apply, Submodule.coe_zero, map_zero] using hval
   165	
   166	/-- Every component of a nonzero global cocycle-glued section on an integral scheme is
   167	a nonzerodivisor, including the vacuous empty-piece case. -/
   168	theorem component_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_global_ne_zero
   169	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C K)] (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C K pi)
   170	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule K D.pieces D.unit ⊤)) (hs : s ≠ 0) (j : D.index) :
   171	    D.component s j ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(relCurve C K, D.pieces j) := by
   172	  by_cases hj : D.pieces j = ⊥
   173	  · letI : Subsingleton Γ(relCurve C K, D.pieces j) := hj ▸ inferInstance
   174	    rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right]
   175	    intro z _
   176	    exact Subsingleton.elim z 0
   177	  · have hUj : ((D.pieces j : Set (relCurve C K))).Nonempty := by
   178	      rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty (D.pieces j : Set (relCurve C K)) with h | h
   179	      · exact (hj (by ext x; rw [h]; simp)).elim
   180	      · exact h
   181	    let hnonempty : Nonempty {x : relCurve C K // x ∈ D.pieces j} := by
   182	      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hUj
   183	      exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩⟩
   184	    haveI : IsDomain Γ(relCurve C K, D.pieces j) :=
   185	      @IsIntegral.component_integral (relCurve C K) _ (D.pieces j) hnonempty
   186	    exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero
   187	      (D.component_ne_zero_of_global_ne_zero s hs j hj)

   192	-- Elaborating the tensor swap and piecewise base-change equivalence needs extra heartbeats.
   193	theorem injective_rTensor_component_of_sectionsMapTop_ne_zero
   194	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
   195	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤)) (p : PrimeSpectrum B)
   196	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField)]
   197	    (hs : D.sectionsMapTop p.asIdeal.ResidueField s ≠ 0) (j : D.index) :
   198	    Function.Injective
   199	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
   200	  let e : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField ≃+*
   201	      Γ(relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField,
   202	        (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).pieces j) :=
   203	    (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm B Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j)
   204	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField).toRingEquiv.trans
   205	        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieceTermBaseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField j).toRingEquiv
   206	  have hvalue : e (D.component s j ⊗ₜ[B] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) =
   207	      (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).component
   208	        (D.sectionsMapTop p.asIdeal.ResidueField s) j := by
   209	    change D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieceTermBaseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField j
   210	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm B Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j)
   211	        p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   212	          (D.component s j ⊗ₜ[B] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField))) = _
   213	    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul,
   214	      D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieceTermBaseChange_one_tmul
   215	        p.asIdeal.ResidueField j (D.component s j),
   216	      ← D.component_sectionsMapTop p.asIdeal.ResidueField s j]
   217	  have hregular : (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).component
   218	        (D.sectionsMapTop p.asIdeal.ResidueField s) j ∈
   219	      nonZeroDivisors Γ(relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField,
   220	        (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).pieces j) :=
   221	    (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).component_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_global_ne_zero
   222	      (D.sectionsMapTop p.asIdeal.ResidueField s) hs j
   223	  have himage : e (D.component s j ⊗ₜ[B] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) ∈
   224	      nonZeroDivisors Γ(relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField,
   225	        (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).pieces j) := by
   226	    rwa [hvalue]
   227	  have hback : e.symm (e (D.component s j ⊗ₜ[B]
   228	      (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField))) ∈
   229	      nonZeroDivisors (Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
   230	    rw [← MulEquivClass.map_nonZeroDivisors e.symm]
   231	    exact ⟨_, himage, rfl⟩
   232	  apply injective_rTensor_mulSectionEnd_of_tmul_mem_nonZeroDivisors B
   233	    (D.component s j) p
   234	  simpa only [e.symm_apply_apply] using hback
   235

    90	    apply hinj
    91	    rw [LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, mul_zero, mul_comm]

    38	/-- The chart index and divisor chosen inside the admissible Abel map can be exposed without

    53	/-- Classifying a section with a representer and then evaluating the Sigma-extended Abel map

    56	theorem abelSigmaChartAff_app_homEquiv_symm

    58	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D)
    59	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    60	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
    61	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
    62	    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (a : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    63	    (s : divFamZarAff C n (Over.mk a)) :
    64	    let q := rep.homEquiv.symm s
    65	    (abelSigmaChartAff C n rep m Z hdeg).app (op Y) q.left =
    66	      (⟨a, (chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app (op (Over.mk a)) s⟩ :
    67	        (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op Y)) := by
    68	  let q := rep.homEquiv.symm s
    69	  change (abelSigmaChartAff C n rep m Z hdeg).app (op Y) q.left =
    70	    (⟨a, (chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app (op (Over.mk a)) s⟩ :
    71	      (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op Y))
    72	  change (⟨q.left ≫ D.hom, _⟩ :
    73	      (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op Y)) =
    74	    ⟨a, (chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app (op (Over.mk a)) s⟩
    75	  refine Over.sigmaExtension_ext (pic0TypeFunctor C) q.w ?_
    76	  let e := Over.mkCongr q.w
    77	  let q' : Over.mk (q.left ≫ D.hom) ⟶ D :=
    78	    Over.homMk (U := Over.mk (q.left ≫ D.hom)) q.left
    79	  change (pic0TypeFunctor C).map e.op
    80	      ((chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app (op (Over.mk a)) s) =
    81	    (chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app
    82	      (op (Over.mk (q.left ≫ D.hom))) (rep.homEquiv q')
    83	  have hhom : e ≫ q = q' := by
    84	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    85	    exact Category.id_comp _
    86	  have hq : rep.homEquiv q = s := by
    87	    dsimp only [q]
    88	    exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply rep.homEquiv s
    89	  have hfamily : rep.homEquiv q' =
    90	      (divFunctorAff C n).map e.op s := by
    91	    calc
    92	      rep.homEquiv q' = rep.homEquiv (e ≫ q) := congrArg rep.homEquiv hhom.symm
    93	      _ = (divFunctorAff C n).map e.op (rep.homEquiv q) := rep.homEquiv_comp e q
    94	      _ = (divFunctorAff C n).map e.op s := congrArg _ hq
    95	  have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    96	    ((chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).naturality e.op) s
    97	  calc
    98	    _ = (chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app
    99	        (op (Over.mk (q.left ≫ D.hom))) ((divFunctorAff C n).map e.op s) := by
   100	      simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using hnat.symm
   101	    _ = _ := congrArg _ hfamily.symm
   102	
   103	omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] in
   104	/-- On an affine test, passing a widened affine family through the inverse vehicle comparison
   105	and then taking its Abel value recovers the direct affine Abel value. -/
   106	theorem picEtAffineEquiv_abelDivAff'_affineEquiv_symm
   107	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] (F : DivFamZarAff C A n) :
   108	    picEtAffineEquiv C A
   109	        (abelDivAff' C n (overSpec k A) ((divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C n A).symm F))
   110	      = abelDivAffPlus C A F := by
   111	  rw [picEtAffineEquiv_abelDivAff', Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
   112	
   113	/-- If the Abel value of a widened family is the inverse chart twist of a target degree-zero
   114	class, then the chart transformation sends that family to the target itself. -/
   115	theorem chartValueAffTrans_app_eq_of_abelDivAff'_eq_chartTwist
   116	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   117	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   118	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
   119	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (s : divFamZarAff C n T)
   120	    (lam : pic0Subgroup C T)
   121	    (habel : abelDivAff' C n T s = chartTwist C m Z T lam.1) :
   122	    (chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app (op T) s = lam := by
   123	  apply Subtype.ext
   124	  rw [chartValueAffTrans_app_coe]
   125	  change chartValueAff C n m Z T s = lam.1
   126	  rw [chartValueAff, habel, chartTwist]
   127	  group

     9	/-!
    10	# Etale-site reduction and affine PicEt honestification
    11	
    12	This file provides the site-theoretic and affine-plus infrastructure used to turn affine
    13	local lifts into local surjectivity on the big etale site. It also packages the passage from
    14	an affine `picEt` class to an honest relative Picard class after restriction to the carrier of
    15	one of its etale presentations.
    16	
    17	The declarations here are independent of the Abel transformation and make no representability
    18	or quotient assertion.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	set_option autoImplicit false
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

    27	namespace AlgebraicGeometry

    30	
    31	/-! ## Reduction to affine tests -/
    32	
    33	/-- A sieve on a scheme is etale-covering if its pullback to every member of the canonical
    34	affine open cover is etale-covering. -/
    35	theorem mem_etaleTopology_of_pullback_affine {T : Scheme.{u}} (S : Sieve T)
    36	    (h : ∀ (j : T.affineCover.I₀), S.pullback (T.affineCover.f j) ∈
    37	      Scheme.etaleTopology (T.affineCover.X j)) :
    38	    S ∈ Scheme.etaleTopology T := by
    39	  have hcov : (Sieve.generate (Presieve.ofArrows T.affineCover.X T.affineCover.f))
    40	      ∈ Scheme.etaleTopology T := by
    41	    apply Scheme.zariskiTopology_le_etaleTopology
    42	    exact Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff.mpr
    43	      ⟨T.affineCover, Sieve.le_generate _⟩
    44	  refine Scheme.etaleTopology.transitive hcov S ?_
    45	  rintro Y g ⟨V, a, b, ⟨j⟩, rfl⟩
    46	  rw [Sieve.pullback_comp]
    47	  exact Scheme.etaleTopology.pullback_stable a (h j)
    48	
    49	/-- To prove local surjectivity on the big etale site, it suffices to produce an etale cover
    50	with local lifts over every affine test scheme. -/
    51	theorem isLocallySurjective_etale_of_affine
    52	    {F G : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : F ⟶ G)
    53	    (h : ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] (s : G.obj (op Y)),
    54	      ∃ (cover : Y.Cover.{u} (Scheme.precoverage @Etale)),
    55	        ∀ j : cover.I₀, ∃ x : F.obj (op (cover.X j)),
    56	          f.app (op (cover.X j)) x = G.map (cover.f j).op s) :
    57	    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology f where
    58	  imageSieve_mem {U} s := by
    59	    apply mem_etaleTopology_of_pullback_affine
    60	    intro j
    61	    rw [Presheaf.pullback_imageSieve]
    62	    obtain ⟨cover, hcover⟩ :=
    63	      h (U.affineCover.X j) (G.map (U.affineCover.f j).op s)
    64	    refine (Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff (P := @Etale)).mpr ⟨cover, ?_⟩
    65	    rintro Y g ⟨i⟩
    66	    exact hcover i
    67	
    68	/-! ## Covers induced by affine etale presentations -/
    69	
    70	/-- The spectrum of the carrier of an algebraic etale cover is a singleton etale cover of
    71	the spectrum of the base algebra. -/
    72	noncomputable def etaleSchemeCover {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    73	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) :
    74	    (Spec (.of A)).Cover (Scheme.precoverage @Etale) :=
    75	  Scheme.Cover.mkOfCovers PUnit (fun _ => Spec (.of E.Carrier))
    76	    (fun _ => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier)))
    77	    (fun x => by
    78	      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := E.comap_surjective x
    79	      exact ⟨PUnit.unit, y, hy⟩)
    80	    (fun _ => by
    81	      rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)]
    82	      exact RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance)
    83	
    84	/-! ## Honestification of affine PicEt classes -/
    85	
    86	namespace PicEtAff
    87	
    88	/-- `mapAlg` agrees with the instance-based affine restriction map when the underlying ring
    89	homomorphism is the chosen `A`-algebra structure on `B`. -/
    90	theorem mapAlg_eq_map_of_toRingHom_eq_algebraMap
    91	    {k A B : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [CommRing B]
    92	    [Algebra k B] [Algebra A B] [IsScalarTower k A B]
    93	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (phi : A →ₐ[k] B)
    94	    (hphi : phi.toRingHom = algebraMap A B) (a : PicEtAff C A) :
    95	    PicEtAff.mapAlg C phi a = PicEtAff.map C B a := by
    96	  have hAlg : phi.toRingHom.toAlgebra = (inferInstance : Algebra A B) :=
    97	    Algebra.algebra_ext _ _ fun r => by
    98	      change phi r = algebraMap A B r
    99	      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hphi r
   100	  unfold PicEtAff.mapAlg
   101	  subst hAlg
   102	  rfl
   103	
   104	/-- Restricting an affine PicEt presentation along the map to its own cover carrier produces
   105	the honest class represented by its descent datum. -/
   106	theorem mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self
   107	    {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   108	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   109	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x : descentClasses C E) :
   110	    PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   111	        (PicEtAff.mk C E x)
   112	      = PicEtAff.unit C E.Carrier
   113	          (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) := by
   114	  rw [mapAlg_eq_map_of_toRingHom_eq_algebraMap C _ rfl]
   115	  exact PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_self C E x
   116	
   117	end PicEtAff
   118	
   119	/-- On affine tests, restricting a `picEt` class to the carrier of one of its plus
   120	presentations agrees with the `picEt` unit of the corresponding honest relative Picard
   121	class. -/
   122	theorem picEtMap_eq_relPicToPicEt_of_affineRepresentative
   123	    {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   124	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   125	    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
   126	    (lam : picEt C (overSpec k A)) (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A)
   127	    (x : descentClasses C E)
   128	    (h : picEtAffineEquiv C A lam = PicEtAff.mk C E x) :
   129	    picEtMap C
   130	        (Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)) lam
   131	      = relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k E.Carrier)
   132	          (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) := by
   133	  apply (picEtAffineEquiv C E.Carrier).injective
   134	  rw [picEtAffineEquiv_naturality, h,
   135	    picEtAffineEquiv_relPicToPicEt,
   136	    PicEtAff.mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self]
